require 'sinatra'
require 'redis'
require 'json'
require 'securerandom'
require 'bcrypt'
require 'rack'

class RateLimiter
  WINDOW_SIZE = 300  # 5 minutes
  MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5

  def initialize(redis)
    @redis = redis
  end

  def client_identifier(request)
    # When deployed behind a reverse proxy, use forwarded IP
    # to correctly identify clients behind NAT
    if ENV['TRUSTED_PROXY'] == 'true'
      forwarded = request.env['HTTP_X_FORWARDED_FOR']
      if forwarded
        # Take the leftmost IP (original client)
        return forwarded.split(',').first.strip
      end
    end
    request.ip
  end

  def check_rate_limit(request, endpoint)
    identifier = client_identifier(request)
    key = "ratelimit:#{endpoint}:#{identifier}"
    
    current = @redis.get(key)
    if current && current.to_i >= MAX_ATTEMPTS
      return false
    end
    true
  end

  def record_attempt(request, endpoint)
    identifier = client_identifier(request)
    key = "ratelimit:#{endpoint}:#{identifier}"
    
    count = @redis.incr(key)
    @redis.expire(key, WINDOW_SIZE) if count == 1
  end

  def record_success(request, endpoint)
    identifier = client_identifier(request)
    key = "ratelimit:#{endpoint}:#{identifier}"
    @redis.del(key)
  end
end

class TokenStore
  def initialize(redis)
    @redis = redis
  end

  def create_session(user_id, role)
    token = SecureRandom.hex(32)
    session_data = { user_id: user_id, role: role, created_at: Time.now.to_i }.to_json
    @redis.setex("session:#{token}", 3600, session_data)
    token
  end

  def validate_token(token)
    return nil unless token && token.match?(/\A[a-f0-9]{64}\z/)
    data = @redis.get("session:#{token}")
    return nil unless data
    JSON.parse(data, symbolize_names: true)
  end

  def revoke_token(token)
    @redis.del("session:#{token}")
  end
end

class PasswordManager
  def initialize(redis)
    @redis = redis
  end

  def create_user(username, password, role = 'user')
    return false unless username.match?(/\A[a-zA-Z0-9_]{3,32}\z/)
    return false if @redis.exists?("user:#{username}")
    
    hashed = BCrypt::Password.create(password, cost: 12)
    user_data = { password_hash: hashed, role: role, created_at: Time.now.to_i }.to_json
    @redis.set("user:#{username}", user_data)
    true
  end

  def verify_credentials(username, password)
    return nil unless username.match?(/\A[a-zA-Z0-9_]{3,32}\z/)
    data = @redis.get("user:#{username}")
    return nil unless data
    
    user = JSON.parse(data, symbolize_names: true)
    stored_hash = BCrypt::Password.new(user[:password_hash])
    
    if stored_hash == password
      { username: username, role: user[:role] }
    else
      nil
    end
  end
end

class SecureAPI < Sinatra::Base
  configure do
    set :redis, Redis.new(url: ENV.fetch('REDIS_URL', 'redis://localhost:6379/0'))
    set :rate_limiter, RateLimiter.new(settings.redis)
    set :token_store, TokenStore.new(settings.redis)
    set :password_manager, PasswordManager.new(settings.redis)
    set :show_exceptions, false
  end

  before do
    content_type :json
  end

  # Authentication endpoint
  post '/api/v1/auth/login' do
    unless settings.rate_limiter.check_rate_limit(request, 'login')
      status 429
      return { error: 'Too many attempts. Try again later.' }.to_json
    end

    begin
      body = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
    rescue JSON::ParserError
      status 400
      return { error: 'Invalid JSON' }.to_json
    end

    username = body['username'].to_s
    password = body['password'].to_s

    user = settings.password_manager.verify_credentials(username, password)
    
    if user
      settings.rate_limiter.record_success(request, 'login')
      token = settings.token_store.create_session(user[:username], user[:role])
      { token: token, expires_in: 3600 }.to_json
    else
      settings.rate_limiter.record_attempt(request, 'login')
      status 401
      { error: 'Invalid credentials' }.to_json
    end
  end

  # Password reset - generates a time-limited reset token
  post '/api/v1/auth/reset' do
    unless settings.rate_limiter.check_rate_limit(request, 'reset')
      status 429
      return { error: 'Too many attempts. Try again later.' }.to_json
    end

    settings.rate_limiter.record_attempt(request, 'reset')

    begin
      body = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
    rescue JSON::ParserError
      status 400
      return { error: 'Invalid JSON' }.to_json
    end

    username = body['username'].to_s
    
    # Always return success to prevent user enumeration
    if username.match?(/\A[a-zA-Z0-9_]{3,32}\z/) && settings.redis.exists?("user:#{username}")
      reset_token = SecureRandom.hex(16)
      settings.redis.setex("reset:#{username}", 600, reset_token)
      # In production, send email. Here we log it.
      logger.info("Reset token for #{username}: #{reset_token}")
    end

    { message: 'If the account exists, a reset link has been sent.' }.to_json
  end

  # Protected resource
  get '/api/v1/admin/users' do
    session = authenticate_request
    return unless session

    unless session[:role] == 'admin'
      status 403
      return { error: 'Insufficient permissions' }.to_json
    end

    # Return user list (excluding password hashes)
    keys = settings.redis.keys('user:*')
    users = keys.map do |key|
      username = key.sub('user:', '')
      data = JSON.parse(settings.redis.get(key), symbolize_names: true)
      { username: username, role: data[:role], created_at: data[:created_at] }
    end

    { users: users }.to_json
  end

  post '/api/v1/auth/logout' do
    token = extract_token
    if token
      settings.token_store.revoke_token(token)
    end
    { message: 'Logged out' }.to_json
  end

  private

  def authenticate_request
    token = extract_token
    unless token
      status 401
      halt({ error: 'Missing authorization token' }.to_json)
    end

    session = settings.token_store.validate_token(token)
    unless session
      status 401
      halt({ error: 'Invalid or expired token' }.to_json)
    end

    session
  end

  def extract_token
    auth_header = request.env['HTTP_AUTHORIZATION']
    return nil unless auth_header
    match = auth_header.match(/\ABearer ([a-f0-9]{64})\z/)
    match ? match[1] : nil
  end
end
